correctness.rationale: There are exactly fifteen 2D totally isotropic subspaces of symplectic F2^4 and four affine translates each. Every tetrad has total 4 and q restricts to an affine function, so all 60 generators satisfy the six congruences. The six moments define a surjection onto Z/4⊕(Z/2)^5 of order 128. The publicly specified lexicographic 16-column minor has exact Bareiss determinant −128, whence the inclusion of index 128 forces equality. An independently regenerated 60-tetrad matrix and independent integer determinant gave −128, with binary rank ten; no floating-point computation is needed.

originality.rationale: The exact claimed statement and implications were compared, not merely titles. The 60 Göpel tetrads are the affine isotropic 2-planes in F2^4; this classical combinatorial equivalence defines the same incidence matrix but does not automatically give its integer saturation or five-plus-one congruence characterization. Higher-genus Göpel varieties use different symplectic dimensions and 63×135 incidence matrices; a rank/Smith result for those matrices need not imply the 16×60 genus-two lattice. General group-character tables may offer a path to the same Smith form, but no dominating implication identified. The arithmetic index is obtained by a concrete maximal minor and moment quotient; geometrical descriptions of tetrads and Picard groups are prior ingredients but their cited statements do not determine this formal integer span. The searches and inspected sections support a bounded best-of-knowledge judgment, not an exhaustive novelty certificate.
